CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE R.NATARAJ  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners have sought for a writ in the nature of certiorari to quash the incomplete award passed by the respondent No.2 in File No.LAQ:KP/CR:15/2019-20 dated 06.01.2022 and to declare the consequential approval of the award in File No.LAQ/KP/CR-18/2019-20 as arbitrary and contrary to the due process of law.

They have also sought for writ in the nature of mandamus to direct the respondents to initiate appropriate proceedings for acquiring the extent of lands of the petitioners as recommended by the respondent Nos.5 and 6 in all NC: 2025:KHC-K:19 measuring 13 acres 36 guntas by considering the representations of the petitioners dated 03.06.2021 and 28.02.2022.
2.
All the petitioners contend that they are the owners of various extent of lands in Hochakanhalli Village, Bagdal Hobli, Bidar Taluk.
They contend that their lands were submerged under the Karanja Project during the year 1984-85.
They claimed that there was no acquisition in respect of their land, but were deprived of its usage.
The petitioners therefore submitted representations to respondent Nos.3 and 6.

The respondent Nos.5 and 6 then recommended for acquisition of additional land in Sy.Nos.41/A, 27, 27/2, 27/3P-1 and 40/1 measuring 13 acres 36 guntas vide correspondence dated 04.08.2016 addressed to the respondent No.1.
3.
The Deputy Commissioner thereafter sought particulars from the respondent No.5 regarding the distance and the extent of property submerged in the backwaters of Karanja Project.

The respondent No.5 NC: 2025:KHC-K:19 recommended initiation of proceedings to acquire the additional extent of land submerged under the project and furnished detailed explanation to the Deputy Commissioner vide his correspondence dated 28.11.2017.
The petitioners contend that the Deputy Commissioner directed the Tahsildar, Bidar to hold a spot panchanama identifying the extent of land submerged.
Accordingly, the Tahsildar furnished a panchanama specifying the names of petitioners and the extent of land that was submerged.

The petitioners contend that though a proposal was made to initiate acquisition of additional extent of 13 acres 36 guntas, the respondent No.2 did not initiate Smt. Kavita And Ors vs The Deputy Commissioner And Ors on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168433555/
4 any proceedings for acquisition, but restricted it in respect of Sy.No.8/2P1 measuring 01 acre and Sy.No.9/P1 measuring 03 acres and on 06.01.2022 an award was passed determining the compensation payable in respect of 04 acres of land.

sentences.text: The petitioners dissatisfied with the market value determined by the respondent No.2 filed representation dated 03.06.2021 requesting the respondent No.2 to initiate acquisition proceedings in NC: 2025:KHC-K:19 respect of entire extent of land that was submerged and as reported by respondent Nos.5 and 6.
A further representation was also filed on 28.02.2022.

The petitioners therefore contend that since their representations are not considered, respondent No.2 is to be directed to consider the representations so that, suitable proceedings are initiated to acquire the land measuring 13 acre 36 guntas belonging to the petitioners instead of 04 acres as stated above.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioners reiterated the aforesaid contentions and contended that the land of the petitioners is submerged under water and the respondent No.2 is bound to compensate for the land utilized for the said project.

5. The learned counsel for the respondent Nos.3, 5 and 6 submits that the representations of the petitioners dated 03.06.2021 and 28.02.2022 would be considered in the light of the report submitted by the Tahsildar, Bidar and the respondent Nos.5 and 6 as stated above.

In view of the aforesaid submission, this writ petition deserves to be disposed off with the following directions :
i) The respondent No.4 is directed to consider the representation of the petitioners as stated above in the light of the report of the Tahsildar as well as report of respondent Nos.3, 5 and 6 and pass appropriate orders regarding acquisition of the land belonging to the petitioners and pay compensation as per the market value and at such rates as prescribed under the schedule to the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
ii) The aforesaid exercise shall be completed within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
iii) The request of the petitioners towards damages for the crops loss shall be considered after the respondent No.4 passes appropriate orders regarding the compensation payable to the petitioners and the same is kept open to be considered at an appropriate stage.
